setName: Yu-Gi-Oh! The Sacred Cards promotional cards

Prismatic Secret Rare.name: Exchange
Prismatic Secret Rare.desc: Both players reveal their hands and add 1 card from each other's hand to their hand.

Prismatic Secret Rare.name: Graceful Dice
Prismatic Secret Rare.desc: Roll a six-sided die. All monsters you currently control gain ATK/DEF equal to the result x 100, until the end of this turn.

Prismatic Secret Rare.name: Negate Attack
Prismatic Secret Rare.desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; negate the attack, then end the Battle Phase.

Prismatic Secret Rare.name: Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth
Prismatic Secret Rare.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Petit Moth" on your 6th turn or later after it was equipped with "Cocoon of Evolution".

Prismatic Secret Rare.name: Riryoku
Prismatic Secret Rare.desc: Target 2 face-up monsters on the field; halve the ATK of 1 monster, and if you do, add that lost ATK to the other monster. These effects last until the end of this turn.

Prismatic Secret Rare.name: Skull Dice
Prismatic Secret Rare.desc: Roll a six-sided die. All monsters your opponent currently controls lose ATK/DEF equal to the result x 100, until the end of this turn.
